findings.message: bed_heated_60K: 'nozzle gap' changes by -0.101 mm when hot (limit 0.1 mm). A machine set up cold would be off by this much at temperature.

data.hint: Set the gap at temperature (probe hot), let the hot part grow from a fixed point near the datum, or isolate it thermally.

findings.message: v11 (b): change after probing during the first layers (heat growth at 80 degC) <= 0.1 mm: (b) change after probing during the first layers: bounded by the whole heat growth from cold to 80 degC (bed 60 K above the frame, carrier 15 K), as if the bed were probed before it had grown at all: nozzle-gap change -0.1010 mm, plate out of flat 0.0299 mm; limit 0.1. A light first-layer print (well under the 1 kg of (c)) adds less than (c)'s figure

data.requirement: v11 (b): change after probing during the first layers (heat growth at 80 degC) <= 0.1 mm

findings.message: 24 screw(s) have between 0.5 d and 0.8 d of thread in their T-nut (least: z_deck_bolt_0, 2.52 mm = 0.50 d) and do not pass the nut's whole thread: the nut is not used to its maker's rating. Tighten to a reduced torque or use the next screw length.

data.hint: A longer standard screw that still ends clear of the slot floor, or one washer fewer; otherwise state a reduced torque.

findings.message: 94 screw(s) pass on the slot and T-nut geometry used but not on '2020 slot 6, B-type (community STEP) + Misumi HNTAJ5 nut' (slot 5.3 mm deep, lip 1.5 mm): 94 would end within 0.5 mm of that floor or on it, 0 would have under 0.5 d of thread; worst: nut_plate_bolt_0 (-0.08 mm from the floor, 0.64 d). findings.message: 4 M3 screw head(s) / nut(s) bear through a washer on abs (part_duct): up to 18 MPa under part_duct_screw_0_nut at a preload of 517 N (declared on the screw (meta['torque_nm']); Bossard, mu 0.14), against 2.5 MPa allowed (PRT-030, DERIVED: 2.5 MPa sustained at 45 degC (meta['service_temp_c']) (5 MPa to 40 degC, 2.5 MPa to 60 degC, none above: keeps printed PETG / ABS in its linear viscoelastic range; no published allowable exists); above the printed yield 30.8 MPa (Stratasys ABS-M30 TDS: XZ yield 30.8 MPa, ZX modulus 2.30 GPa; across layers DERIVED (PETG's 14/47 ratio)) the surface crushes on tightening); that seat carries 71 N, about 0.04 N.m. The seat creeps or embeds and the joint loses its preload.

data.hint: PRT-030: on printed plastic a washer and a metal sleeve (compression limiter) through the hole so the clamp load goes through metal, and locking that does not need preload (nyloc); or Put a flat washer under the head or nut (add_screw(..., washer=True), add_washer; series='large' spreads further), bear on a metal part instead, or state the torque you will really use (design.manufacturing['tightening_torque_nm']).

findings.message: bed_magnet is marked off-the-shelf but did not come from the parts catalog (dimensions and ratings unverified).

Bed probe 'bed_probe' is offset (0, 34.5) mm from the nozzle and kept 12 mm inside the plate edge, so strips of the print area are never probed: {'y_low': 34.5, 'y_high': np.float64(9.25)} (mm wide; print area declared: design.printer['print_area'] = 191.6 x 214.5 mm, centred on the plate). The firmware holds the nearest measured value there.

data.hint: Acceptable if the bed is flat at the edges; otherwise move the probe closer to the nozzle or shrink the print area.

findings.message: Heater 'extruder': a shorted MOSFET is survived only because the firmware drops the supply relay (peak 282 degC). There is no cut-off that works if the controller has also hung.
Loom 'gantry': the straight line between its two clamps passes through 'leadscrew_fl' at pose {'y': 76.6}; the free loop has to bend round it and may rub.

The only assembly order found installs something before the part that supports it (around ['bed_thumb_0', 'bed_thumb_0_washer', 'bed_thumb_1', 'bed_thumb_1_washer', 'bed_thumb_2', 'bed_thumb_2_washer']); it would need holding in place.

data.hint: Add a locating feature, change which part carries the screws, or put the parts in one bench sub-assembly.

findings.message: A 1 kg print at the worst corner of the print area lowers the print surface there by 0.035 mm (bonded joints 0.034, screw-only joints 0.035; of which guides and nut 0.001), more than 0.1 of a 0.2 mm layer (0.020 mm). The bed is levelled and meshed empty, so neither sees it.

data.hint: Shorten the overhang, space the guide blocks further apart along the rail, stiffen the arms, or support the bed at a second or third point.

parts.name: carriage_plate_left
parts.desc: Carriage plate (left): one of three identical flat 1.6 mm 6061 plates. Its top 20 mm is bolted to the 2020 square's outer face (two M5, T-nuts); its bottom carries the guide block z_carriage_left (four M3 x 5 into the block's own threads). The 30 mm web between them is a flexure: stiff along the wall, soft square to it (251 N/mm), so this block locates the carrier along the wall only and a rail that is not exactly parallel, or a carrier that has grown warm, bends the web instead of loading the block.

parts.name: carriage_plate_right
parts.desc: Carriage plate (right): one of three identical flat 1.6 mm 6061 plates. Its top 20 mm is bolted to the 2020 square's outer face (two M5, T-nuts); its bottom carries the guide block z_carriage_right (four M3 x 5 into the block's own threads). The 30 mm web between them is a flexure: stiff along the wall, soft square to it (251 N/mm), so this block locates the carrier along the wall only and a rail that is not exactly parallel, or a carrier that has grown warm, bends the web instead of loading the block.

parts.name: carriage_plate_rear
parts.desc: Carriage plate (rear): one of three identical flat 1.6 mm 6061 plates. Its top 20 mm is bolted to the 2020 square's outer face (two M5, T-nuts); its bottom carries the guide block z_carriage_rear (four M3 x 5 into the block's own threads). The 30 mm web between them is a flexure: stiff along the wall, soft square to it (251 N/mm), so this block locates the carrier along the wall only and a rail that is not exactly parallel, or a carrier that has grown warm, bends the web instead of loading the block.

parts.name: nut_plate
parts.desc: Laser-cut 6061 nut plate under the carrier's square. How the bed is lifted: the POM anti-backlash nut z_nut (supplied on the motor's screw; dimensions a STAND-IN) rides lead screw leadscrew. Its square flange is under this 9.525 mm plate, which is bolted under the 2020 square's member sq_rear (two M5 from below into T-nuts) and reaches 57.1 mm out to the screw; the nut's barrel hangs below. The carrier's weight rests on the flange, so when the screw turns the nut climbs it and lifts the plate, the square, the deck and the bed. The M2.5 pin screw nut_pin (through a 5 mm aluminium sleeve, fixed in a corner hole of the flange) sits in a radial slot in the plate: it stops the nut turning with the screw while letting it float 2.8 mm sideways. The nut is captive: the laser-cut keeper nut_keeper, bolted 0.1 mm under the flange on two M3 through-bolts and spacers, stops the plate lifting off it.

printer_cfg:
# printer.cfg for printer_v11: GENERATED by mechloop from the electrical model. Do not edit by hand;
# change the design and regenerate. Directions (dir_pin '!') and the extruder rotation_distance must be
# confirmed on the machine; PID values come from a simulated PID_CALIBRATE and should be re-run on the real heater.
# Input shaper, pressure advance and probe offsets below are PREDICTIONS from the simulation, each resting on
# assumed values named beside it: re-measure on the machine (SHAPER_CALIBRATE, a pressure-advance test print,
# PROBE_CALIBRATE, BED_MESH_CALIBRATE).

[mcu]
# klipper_mcu: stm32f446
serial: /dev/ttyAMA0
restart_method: command

[printer]
kinematics: cartesian
max_velocity: 250
max_accel: 4000
max_z_velocity: 12
max_z_accel: 200

[stepper_x]
step_pin: PF13
dir_pin: PF12
enable_pin: !PF14
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40
endstop_pin: ^PG6
position_endstop: 191.6
position_min: 0
position_max: 191.6
homing_speed: 50
homing_positive_dir: true

[tmc2209 stepper_x]
uart_pin: PC4
run_current: 0.280
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_y]
step_pin: PG0
dir_pin: PG1
enable_pin: !PF15
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40
endstop_pin: ^PG9
position_endstop: 214.5
position_min: 0
position_max: 214.5
homing_speed: 50
homing_positive_dir: true

[tmc2209 stepper_y]
uart_pin: PD11
run_current: 1.200
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_y1]
step_pin: PF11
dir_pin: PG3
enable_pin: !PG5
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40

[tmc2209 stepper_y1]
uart_pin: PC6
run_current: 1.200
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_z]
step_pin: PG4
dir_pin: PC1
enable_pin: !PA0
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 2
endstop_pin: probe:z_virtual_endstop
position_min: -1.550
position_max: 183.100
homing_speed: 5
second_homing_speed: 1
homing_retract_dist: 3

[tmc2209 stepper_z]
uart_pin: PC7
run_current: 0.800
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_z1]
step_pin: PC13
dir_pin: PF0
enable_pin: !PF1
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 2

[tmc2209 stepper_z1]
uart_pin: PE4
run_current: 0.800
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_z2]
step_pin: PE2
dir_pin: PE3
enable_pin: !PD4
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 2

[tmc2209 stepper_z2]
uart_pin: PE1
run_current: 0.800
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[z_tilt]
z_positions:
    111.3, 305.25
    -33.2, 1.75
    255.8, 1.75
points:
    95.8, 185
    10, 5
    181.6, 5
speed: 100
horizontal_move_z: 5
retries: 5
retry_tolerance: 0.0075

[extruder]
step_pin: PF9
dir_pin: PF10
enable_pin: !PG2
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 26.8937
gear_ratio: 11.262:1
full_steps_per_rotation: 400
nozzle_diameter: 0.400
filament_diameter: 1.750
heater_pin: PA2
sensor_type: ATC Semitec 104NT-4-R025H42G
sensor_pin: PF4
control: pid
pid_Kp: 42.921
pid_Ki: 16.832
pid_Kd: 27.362
min_temp: 0
max_temp: 280
max_extrude_only_distance: 100
max_extrude_only_velocity: 60
max_extrude_only_accel: 3000
# pressure advance: equal to the twin's 32 ms melt-flow lag (direct drive, 0.4 mm nozzle: factory pressure-advance values (fitted_parameters.json: extruder_lag_s), range 0.02 to 0.058 s); not measured on this machine, no sweep run: print a pressure-advance test
pressure_advance: 0.0315
pressure_advance_smooth_time: 0.04

[tmc2209 extruder]
uart_pin: PF2
run_current: 0.400
sense_resistor: 0.110

[heater_bed]
heater_pin: PA1
sensor_type: Generic 3950
sensor_pin: PF3
control: pid
pid_Kp: 72.201
pid_Ki: 3.619
pid_Kd: 360.105
min_temp: 0
max_temp: 90

[verify_heater extruder]
max_error: 120
check_gain_time: 20
hysteresis: 5
heating_gain: 2

[verify_heater heater_bed]
max_error: 120
check_gain_time: 60
hysteresis: 5
heating_gain: 2

[fan]
pin: PA8

# fan 'hotend_fan' is wired to the board's +5 V rail: it runs whenever the machine is powered (no firmware section)

# mains relay ahead of the 24 V supply: energised while the firmware runs, dropped on any shutdown
[output_pin ps_on]
pin: PE11
value: 1
shutdown_value: 0

# input shaper: predicted by the twin, not measured: resonance X 73.6 Hz, Y 71.3 Hz (belt stiffness only, no FEA frame stiffness); damping assumed. Run SHAPER_CALIBRATE
[input_shaper]
shaper_type_x: ei
shaper_freq_x: 92.8
damping_ratio_x: 0.065
shaper_type_y: mzv
shaper_freq_y: 71.8
damping_ratio_y: 0.069

# probe: offsets from the CAD; z_offset from the probe's nominal switching distance on steel (4.0 mm) - set it on the machine with PROBE_CALIBRATE
# that distance: OMRON E2B data sheet (vendor_docs/omron_E2B_datasheet_en.pdf): p.2 ordering, p.7 ratings (M12, double distance, shielded), p.15 dimensions (E2B-M12KS04-WP), p.20 surrounding metal (double distance, shielded, M12): 4 mm +/-10 % on the standard iron target
[probe]
pin: ^!PG10
x_offset: 0
y_offset: 34.5
z_offset: 2.000
speed: 5
lift_speed: 10
samples: 3
samples_result: median
sample_retract_dist: 2
samples_tolerance: 0.04
samples_tolerance_retries: 3

# Z homes with the probe over the middle of the bed
[safe_z_home]
home_xy_position: 95.8, 72.75
speed: 100
z_hop: 5
z_hop_speed: 5

# mesh bounds are probe positions: the bed inset by the probe's edge margin, cut to where the probe can reach
[bed_mesh]
speed: 100
horizontal_move_z: 5
mesh_min: 0, 34.5
mesh_max: 191.6, 205.25
probe_count: 5, 5
algorithm: lagrange
mesh_pps: 2, 2
fade_start: 1
fade_end: 10
fade_target: 0
split_delta_z: 0.01
zero_reference_position: 95.8, 107.25
